mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, i.id AS item_id, i.order_id AS item_order_id, i.product_id, i.product_name, i.product_price, i.quantity, i.subtotal FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item i ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
